description: This is the main activity class for an Android application that manages device restrictions, including profile setup, status checks, and fragment transactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entry point activity managing device profile setup, application status, and user interface fragments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, determines profile setup state, and displays appropriate UI fragments.

methods.name: showSetupProfile
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment with the setup profile fragment.

methods.name: showStatusProfile
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment with the status fragment.

methods.name: showMainFragment
methods.description: Replaces the current fragment with the main application fragment.

methods.name: onStatusUpdated
methods.description: Callback triggered when the status is updated, switching to the main fragment.
